public_body: Woburn Public Library Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found the Woburn Public Library Board of Trustees violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a June 2, 2020 virtual meeting notice with a shortened, incomplete Zoom link. It declined to review the claim that minutes were not posted online, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: The June 2, 2020 virtual meeting notice omitted the full Zoom access link, so the public could not readily join the meeting remotely.
allegations.key_passage: The Board concedes that the notice for the June 2 meeting did not contain the full link necessary to access the Zoom meeting, as the link had been shortened by inadvertent error.

allegations.summary: The complainant alleged the Board's meeting minutes were not publicly available on the City's website.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Board that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
